name: @corkboards/core
//exports: No barrel entry point on purpose. Every consumer imports a specific module by path (`@core/noteClassifier`, …) via the web/mobile `@core/*` alias, so `src/index.ts` was dead weight AND perpetually stale — it re-exported about two thirds of the modules and nothing noticed, because nothing imported it. A subpath-only `exports` map means a new module is reachable the moment it exists, with no list to forget to update.

scripts.test: tsc --noEmit && eslint && vitest run && echo 'Core checks passed!'
